hidden_darts.name: Flying Feather Darts
hidden_darts.description: A set of concealed throwing darts that can be launched in rapid succession.

sleeve_arrows.name: Spring-Loaded Sleeve Arrows
sleeve_arrows.description: A mechanism strapped to the forearm launches small bolts at the flick of a wrist. Almost impossible to detect.

smoke_bombs.name: Smoke-Powder Grenades
smoke_bombs.description: Clay spheres packed with blinding powder. Not a weapon in the classical sense, but invaluable for creating distance.
